title: Interactive design comparison: CivicPortal
description: A fictional A/B usability experiment comparing two implementations of a sample account portal.
welcome: You will explore one version of a fictional account portal and perform two short activities. There is no real account information.
consent: I agree to take part. I understand that this study records my assigned prototype version, click/navigation events from the demo, task timing, task responses, and survey answers. I will not enter sensitive information.

tasks.title: Find your most recent service request
tasks.instructions: Find the details and status of the most recent service request in your account.

questions.text: How easy or difficult was it to find the service request?
What, if anything, made this task difficult?

tasks.title: Find your latest account notification
tasks.instructions: Find and open the latest account notification in your account.

questions.text: How easy or difficult was it to find the notification?

postQuestions.text: How clear was the account navigation overall?
